City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 17, 2021 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.

Overview of the San Diego County Citizens’ Law Enforcement Review Board (CLERB) by Paul Parker, CLERB Executive Officer.
2021-03-17 Item 04B CLERB - Presentation
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the February 24, 2021 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2021-03-17 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Reject bids for MacKinnon Avenue ADA Sidewalk Improvements (CS20D). Contact Person: Associate Engineer Kirk
1) Reject all bids from the January 26, 2020 bid opening for the MacKinnon Avenue ADA Sidewalk Improvements (CS20D); and 2) Authorize staff to re-advertise and rebid MacKinnon Avenue ADA Sidewalk Improvements (CS20D).
2021-03-17 Item 08B Reject Bids for Mackinnon Avenue ADA Sidewalk Improvements CS20D
8C.
An amendment to the existing Civic Solutions, Inc. contract agreement of $45,000 for additional Planner support for the remainder of Fiscal Year 2020-21. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Noel
Authorize the City Manager to amend the current contract agreement with Civic Solutions, Inc. in substantial form, in consultation with the City Attorney, to include a total of $45,000 for general Planner support for a total not-to-exceed contract amount of $641,000.
2021-03-17 Item 08C Civic Solutions Contract Amendment #7
8D.
Recreation Instructor Agreement for Independent Contract Services – Crystal Hollins, DBA CLHK Incorporated – Amendment No. 2. Contact Person: Recreation Services Manager Karlen
Authorize the City Manager to execute amendment number 2 of the Instructor Agreement for Independent Contract Services between the City of Encinitas and Crystal Hollins, DBA CLHK Incorporated, in conjunction with the City Attorney in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, commencing upon the date of its execution by the City to amend the instructor payment terms.
2021-03-17 Item 08D Recreation Instructor Agreement – Crystal Hollins, DBA CLHK Inc Amendment No 2
8E.
Amendment #2 to add additional services to the JPW Communications, LLC Agreement to fulfillment of the basic communication needs for the remainder of FY 2020/21. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Authorize the City Manager to execute a contract amendment in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, in conjunction with the City Attorney, adding $25,000 to the existing JPW Agreement for a contract not-to-exceed total of $269,545. if all contract extensions are executed.
2021-03-17 Item 08E JPW Amendment #2

Council Member Initiated Agenda Item from Deputy Mayor Kranz and Council Member Hinze regarding Increased oversight for short term vacation rentals.
Direct staff to return with enhancements to the City’s ordinance regulating permitting, enforcement, and collection of tourist occupancy fees of short-term vacation rentals.

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON MARCH 24, 2021
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
